gloom_wave.name: Gloom Wave
gloom_wave.description: Give the blade to the dark and let it loose in a wave. It breaks over every enemy in the room, and the dark takes an eighth of your own life for it.
gloom_wave.cast_message: {caster_name} draws the dark blade and looses a wave of shadow!
gloom_wave.hit_message: The wave breaks over {target_name} for {value} damage!

cure.name: Cure
cure.self_heal_message: A warm light closes your wounds, restoring {value} health!

fog_breath.name: Fog Breath
fog_breath.cast_message: {caster_name} exhales a rolling bank of fog!

call_colossus.name: Call Colossus
call_colossus.description: Sing the calling and a colossus rises for a moment to shake the whole room, then is gone. The calling takes a quarter of your life to make, and needs an enemy to answer to.
call_colossus.cast_message: {caster_name} sings the calling, and the ground answers...
call_colossus.hit_message: The Colossus's quake splits the ground under {target_name} for {value} damage!

bat_screech.name: Screech
bat_screech.description: A shriek that rattles the skull.

mist_breath.name: Mist Breath
mist_breath.description: A freezing wave of mist that breaks over everyone in reach.
mist_breath.cast_message: [[RED]]{caster_name} breathes out a roiling wave of freezing mist![[/]]

ember.name: Ember
ember.cast_message: {caster_name} cups her hands and breathes on a spark.
ember.hit_message: The flame leaps at {target_name} for {value} damage!

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.description: A hooked line of white fire from the head of a staff.
lightning.cast_message: {caster_name} raises the staff, and the cavern goes white.

tidal_slam.name: Tidal Slam
tidal_slam.description: A wall of black water thrown across the cavern.
tidal_slam.cast_message: [[RED]]{caster_name} throws a wall of black water across the cavern![[/]]
tidal_slam.hit_message: The water slams into {target_name} for {value} damage!

lullaby.name: Lullaby
lullaby.description: A slow, sweet air that closes eyes.
lullaby.cast_message: {caster_name} plays a slow, sweet air, and the room grows heavy.

hush.name: Hush
hush.description: A song of held breath, that takes the voice out of a throat.
hush.cast_message: {caster_name} plucks a single hushed chord, and the air goes dead.

discord.name: Discord
discord.description: A wrong, wrenching chord that makes friends of no one.

sand_torrent.name: Sand Torrent
sand_torrent.description: A roaring wave of grit thrown across the pit.
sand_torrent.cast_message: [[RED]]{caster_name} throws a roaring torrent of sand across the pit![[/]]

raise.name: Raise
raise.description: A white-magic breath that brings a fallen friend back to their feet.
raise.cast_message: {caster_name} kneels, hands pressed to a friend's chest.

cinder_burst.name: Cinder Burst
cinder_burst.description: A bomb's last, bright, stupid idea.
cinder_burst.cast_message: {caster_name} bursts in a ball of white fire!
cinder_burst.hit_message: The blast rolls over {target_name} for {value} damage!

kick.name: Kick
kick.description: A heel driven straight through whatever stands there.
kick.cast_message: {caster_name} sets his feet and drives a heel forward!
kick.hit_message: The kick lands on {target_name} for {value} damage!

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: A held breath that closes a wound.
focus.cast_message: {caster_name} breathes out slowly, and stands straighter.

dragoon_leap.name: Leap
dragoon_leap.description: Up, out of sight, and down again with the spear first.

windup.leave_message: {caster_name} bends, and is gone into the sky!
windup.land_message: {caster_name} comes down out of the sun on {target_name}!

dragoon_leap.hit_message: The spear drives into {target_name} for {value} damage!

cinder_spit.name: Cinder Spit
cinder_spit.cast_message: {caster_name} lobs a gobbet of burning slag!

maelrake_surge.name: Surge
maelrake_surge.cast_message: [[RED]]{caster_name} heaves a wall of grey sea over the deck![[/]]
maelrake_surge.hit_message: The sea slams into {target_name} for {value} damage!

apprentice_bolt.name: Bolt
apprentice_bolt.cast_message: {caster_name} flicks his fingers, and the air cracks.

apprentice_mend.name: Mend
apprentice_mend.description: A child's first white magic, and quite enough.

twin_storm.name: Twin Storm
twin_storm.description: Two apprentices, one spell, and a storm.
twin_storm.cast_message: [[CYAN]]Tobin and Tamsin clasp hands, and the sky answers them![[/]]
twin_storm.hit_message: The storm tears into {target_name} for {value} damage!

twin_ward.name: Twin Ward
twin_ward.description: Two apprentices, one spell, and a wall.
twin_ward.cast_message: [[CYAN]]Tamsin and Tobin clasp hands, and a hush falls over everyone near them.[[/]]
twin_ward.heal_message: {caster_name} and her brother mend {target_name} for {value} health!

smite.name: Smite
smite.description: A blow of the light, aimed.
smite.cast_message: {caster_name} raises the blade, and it is full of morning.
smite.hit_message: The light falls on {target_name} for {value} damage!

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.cast_message: [[YELLOW]]{caster_name} lifts a hand, and the dark flinches![[/]]

mercy.name: Mercy
mercy.description: What the light does for friends.
mercy.cast_message: {caster_name} lays a hand on the wound.
mercy.self_heal_message: A gentle light closes your wounds, restoring {value} health!

grave_chill.name: Grave Chill
grave_chill.description: A cold that does not come from weather.
grave_chill.cast_message: {caster_name} breathes out a cold that stops the candles.

bone_drain.name: Bone Drain
bone_drain.description: A cold hand closing round the life in you.
bone_drain.cast_message: {caster_name} clutches at the air, and something in you tugs.

shadow_tide.name: Dark Tide
shadow_tide.description: The dark, paid for in the caster's own blood.
shadow_tide.cast_message: [[RED]]{caster_name} draws the dark up out of its own veins and throws it![[/]]
shadow_tide.hit_message: The black wave breaks over {target_name} for {value} damage!

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.description: The forbidden spell: a star brought down on everything. It costs more than any one life holds.
meteor.hit_message: A star falls on {target_name} for {value} damage!
